olivia: Hey — bringing up a new HF model (llama-3-like). Streaming showed lots of early truncation.
olivia: Root cause looks tied to multiple eos tokens in tokenizer.special_tokens_map + config.json eos_token_id mismatch.
nina: Can you paste the tokenizer config? also are you converting with `transformers` to our runtime? 
olivia: Pasting snippet:
```
"special_tokens_map": {"eos_token": "</s>", "additional_special_tokens": ["[END]", "</s>"]},
"tokenizer_config": {"eos_token_id": 2}
```
sam: aha — two different eos markers. Our stream stops on first matching token id. If the tokenizer maps `</s>` and `[END]` to different ids but both considered eos in different places, we get weird multiple termination events.
olivia: Interesting — we also saw a case where quantized INT8 logits caused a 1-bit flip around eos id making model emit alternate eos token more often after quantization.
nina: Yeah quantization can change softmax mass slightly; if two eos-ish tokens are close in logit space, rounding can push the wrong one over threshold during sampling.
qa: Repro steps? I can run regression harness.
olivia: Repro: send prompt that ends with sentinel text, stream with `stop=["</s>"]`, conversion via `transformers-cli convert` + our `hf-to-redwood` tool. Then sample top-p=0.95 temperature=0.7. Often stream ends two tokens earlier with a stray `[END]`.
sam: Workaround: canonicalize tokenizer to single eos id and normalize special_tokens_map -> remove duplicate markers; update config.json `eos_token_id` to match final tokenizer, and set `stop_sequences` in chat template to explicit strings not ids.
nina: Also adding a streaming-layer dedupe helps: if we see EOS token emitted but next token is also EOS id (or any token in configured eos_set) ignore repeated EOS until N tokens or until logit drop. simple patch:
```
if tok in eos_set and prev_tok in eos_set: ignore
```
but need to be careful for real repeated eos that intent to close multiple chat frames.
olivia: Filed ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-4321
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled for canary @ infra tomorrow 03:00 UTC :rocket:
qa: I'll run quantized vs fp16 A/B with 500 prompts and post eval metrics here.
olivia: Thanks — will try tokenizer normalization + small quantization tweak (per-channel scale) and report.
nina: One more: check chat templates where `stop` is a substring; sometimes tokenizer splits `</s>` into `</` and `s>` on some tokenizers, so matching by raw string vs token id differs. Prefer canonical token ids for internal routing.
qa: noted. will run both string-match and id-match checks.
sam: If this gets flaky in dedicated infra, we should have a fallback policy to use a compatible model variant (fp16) instead of quantized for streaming endpoints.
olivia: agree. I'll add to rollout policy.
